instructions_to_main_agent: Always maintain strict testability with data-testid on buttons, inputs, modals, map pins, and presentation toggles.
Ensure Presentation Mode respects the 2:1 aspect ratio container scaling with custom zoom controls for 14x7 ft screens.
When hovering or selecting a sector, dim all other sectors to 0.2 opacity while illuminating the active sector with 0.7 opacity and vibrant glowing borders.
When a household pin is clicked, display a detailed drawer/dialog showing every authorized resident residing at that coordinate rather than just one single person.
Support full CRUD for custom sectors with vertex dragging, snap-to-roads integration, Shapely validation backend contracts, and RBAC check.
Use sonner for notifications and toasts. Avoid raw JavaScript alert popups.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attribute: Every interactive element MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.header_transparency: Headers and overlays MUST have backdrop-blur and a non-transparent background color (e.g. bg-slate-950/90).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toast_library: Use sonner imported from src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or custom wrapper.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.file_extension: All React frontend files must use .js extension.
